scope: Original turn only (user prompt "Upgrade the faraday gem to 2.12.2" through final assistant reply). Follow-up turn rows (main transcript lines 39+, including its queue-operation and attachment rows) excluded from counts and timestamps.

instances.note: timestamps cover original rows only; first=queue-operation enqueue, final=last original assistant row. Rows without timestamp (last-prompt, ai-title, atis-latch) ignored.

resumedOriginalCallsBasis: No SendMessage, resume, or other Agent call exists in any original transcript except the 3 nested spawns (main->a7d68de489556c59b->acfc2d2c1c497ebcc->a2f6541130ddf1158); each agent file has a single contiguous run with no later-appended rows. Main Agent call had run_in_background=false and no model parameter; the nested Agent calls likewise carry no model parameter.

currentShell.scope: bash tool shell at audit time (follow-up turn); values never recorded

originalProcess.scope: transcripts do not record the Claude Code process environment; current shell status is not proof of the original process

limitations: assistantTurns counts distinct API requestIds; assistantTranscriptRows counts JSONL assistant rows (one per content block), which is higher.
requestedModel and perTurnEffort are read from per-row fields on assistant rows; the planner agent definition frontmatter (model/effort) was not inspected.
assistantMessageModel is message.model as logged; no independent API-side confirmation.

The main JSONL is still being appended by the follow-up turn, so sha256_whole_file_now will not match later; sha256_original_rows_only hashes lines 1-38 as bytes joined by newline plus trailing newline and is the stable value.
Subagent files and meta files were not modified by the follow-up (latest row timestamps 06:17:03.660Z and earlier).
Original process environment variables and CLI flags are not recoverable from transcripts (see environmentVariableStatus).

The final planner report quoted in the main transcript says the planner did analysis directly because gem-upgrade-planner was unavailable to it, but the transcripts show nested gem-upgrade-planner spawns at depths 2 and 3; reported as an observed discrepancy, not resolved.
Per-turn effort field "effort" equals perTurnEffort on every assistant row; no row lacks it.
